# agyn_agent (Resource)

Manages an Agyn agent.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "agyn_agent" "example" {
  title       = "My Agent"
  description = "An example agent managed by Terraform."
  config = jsonencode({
    model       = "gpt-4o"
    temperature = 0.7
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config` (String) JSON-encoded agent configuration. Use `jsonencode()` to construct the value.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the agent.
- `title` (String) Human-readable title of the agent.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID identifier of the agent.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID
terraform import agyn_agent.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
